frames.name: The bay
frames.see: Your hull in pieces on a plague world under a star too big for the sky. A walker with dead actuators. The engineer, with a torch.

frames.name: The hold
frames.see: Every wave she fights or she fixes, never both. You leave when the hull is whole and the waves are still coming.

frames.name: The ring under the star
frames.see: Two or three worlds of ordinary business while the star swells and reddens and nothing names it.

frames.name: The star
frames.see: On a takeoff it goes. A shell shoves everything outward. The light is gone, the pit is still there, and it starts to grow.

frames.name: The road
frames.see: Eight to twelve worlds, the whole map known, the gate marked, and an edge that is wherever your engines lose to the pull.

frames.name: The wrecks
frames.see: Everything the shell threw out is falling back in, and the grappler eats it. Your ship is built from it.

frames.name: The price
frames.see: Every station lists a price for her. A pirate demands her or your cargo, whichever is worth more.

frames.name: The gate
frames.see: Shut until she fixes it, with time, scrap, and modules. Then pay the toll and pass. Cannot pay? Sell your ship to the Fitters, module by module.

frames.name: The card
frames.see: What came through, what the hole ate, and the name the galaxy gave you.

gaps.name: The mech bay
gaps.what: The walker rides only if a mech bay module is welded: it carries the rig's mass, sets the walker beside the hull at landing, boards it at takeoff.

gaps.name: The engineer as one figure
gaps.what: Her price and hire-out in space, her body on the ground, fight or fix: one state on both sides of the seam.

gaps.name: The gate by seed
gaps.what: Working with a high toll, broken, blockaded, or both, rolled by the seed; the blockade reuses the pirates with the holder's coin.

gaps.name: A save of the whole run
gaps.what: The road, the registry of worlds, the log, and the ground as one saved run.

gaps.name: Dialogue as data and the ship computer
gaps.what: Lines as speaker, trigger, condition, text; the ship's own flat voice reading instruments and records.

gaps.name: The star in every frame
gaps.what: A camera law that keeps MORS in frame, bigger and redder per landing, and holds the shot at the collapse.

gaps.name: The ground's light
gaps.what: The one light from the star reddening per landing, the shadows lengthening.

gaps.name: The hands' words
gaps.what: A hand unpaid walks, the home line when the hole takes her world, the card's list of who did not come through.

gaps.name: Tramps that leave
gaps.what: Plain bodies on a burn schedule leaving the near stations for the gate, never coming back.

gaps.name: The plague world
gaps.what: No market, the Grip's ground; the galaxy carries the world's kind.

gaps.name: The scrub as a listing line
gaps.what: A clawed hull carries the Grip; a station scrubs it for a price on the listing.

gaps.name: Weapons on the hull
gaps.what: The slug driver, the rack, the shield, from deadweight's lift, so a blockade can be fought and the sold module kinds do something.

gaps.name: The storyteller
gaps.what: A seeded pacer with a quiet dial at zero; may delay a wave, never shrinks one, never touches the hole.

gaps.name: The walker at the ruled scale
gaps.what: Twice a trooper's height, standing. Open on coldsnap's bench.

gaps.name: Sound
gaps.what: Coldsnap's procedural engine on the ground; nothing in space yet.

gaps.name: Onboarding
gaps.what: The first minute explained; the ship computer's lines are the candidate.

parts.name: determinism
parts.does: The seeded stream and the state hash.

parts.name: market
parts.does: Pools whose price moves with every trade.

parts.name: ledger
parts.does: Every unit declared at genesis, audited to zero drift.

parts.name: escrow
parts.does: Contracts with escrow, rescues, the Authority's pay.

parts.name: builder
parts.does: Ports, welds, mass and thrust, connectivity, rotate, remove.

parts.name: wells
parts.does: The field, the pair's orbit, the stop prediction.

parts.name: grapple
parts.does: Cast, bite, reel, yank, snap.

parts.name: aim
parts.does: Frozen-time aiming: the cone, the shot prediction.

parts.name: render2d
parts.does: The projection, the warp, the gravity-warped grid.

parts.name: tape
parts.does: Every action with its tick; the replay is the save.

parts.name: the world's extras
parts.does: The nebula's drag, the gusher as a repelling well, the comet, the rocks that fall in and feed the eaten mass, the boundary, the frontier that replaces the dead, the sun's heat and kill radius.

parts.name: the flight
parts.does: The ship as a rigid body: thrust at each mount, torque off the balance point, the thruster quads, fuel as mass, the wells, the kill radii, the boundary, docking; the mass books; dock, undock, launch, the ship rebuilt from the build list; death, respawn on debt, the run's end; the rating mode.

parts.name: welds in flight
parts.does: Load from thrust and impact, breaking, the ship splitting, shed modules becoming wreckage.

parts.name: the hangar
parts.does: The parts tray priced from the docked pools, tap to place, rotate, remove, blueprints, the module card, the build drawn with couplers and the balance mark, the hull gallery, the wallet, FLY.

parts.name: weapons
parts.does: The slug driver with recoil at its mount, the rack's four birds, lead and intercept, the shield that drinks fuel, dust and burn effects.

parts.name: salvage
parts.does: Scavenging a wreck into the hold, hot goods fenced at a cut, salvage sold by station rate, the hold dumped under a lock.

parts.name: the fabric
parts.does: Every mass as one list for the rope and the shell; bodies tied by the rope pull both ways.

parts.name: the sling planner
parts.does: A planned burn at a chosen point on the swing, committed in frozen time.

parts.name: tramps
parts.does: The arbitrage brain, their mass and value, death and respawn from the frontier, derelicts that become tows.

parts.name: pirates
parts.does: Roost, mark the richest, chase, lock, demand, fire, cool; paying; the Authority's purse and the bounty.

parts.name: the scene drawing
parts.does: Box prisms, module glyphs and letters, bodies wearing their station of origin, shadows, couplers, the balance mark, faceted planets in their pits, the sun and its kill ring, the hole, the field rings, tramps, the line, pirates, wreckage, crates, stations, the gate, the plumes, weld seams tinted by load, the coast line, the ship panel, the minimap.

parts.name: the page's loop and rail
parts.does: The fixed step, the camera follow with burn shake and auto-zoom near wells, the rail, the flight readout, the intro card, the report, the badge, the theme switch.

parts.name: galaxy
parts.does: One seed makes the worlds with radius, gravity, climate, ring, holder, station, and hands; the gate with toll and bill; the collapse count; names, women and men.

parts.name: road
parts.does: The point ship under the wells law; the hole's mass steps, the schedule ahead, the edge per hull move into the ark's layer.

parts.name: the page
parts.does: One file holding every screen today; to be split, one file per screen, the main file keeping the hookups.

parts.name: stations
parts.does: Hands by name at a rising price, wages due at dock, debt, the people contract, carry and deliver; on top of deadweight's markets.

parts.name: wrecks
parts.does: The shell, the field, the grappler at real scale; deadweight's wreckage and grapple take over.

parts.name: price
parts.does: Her price by ring, the factions' listings, the hire-out, the bounty's purse; the lock joins deadweight's pirates demanding her or the cargo.

parts.name: gate
parts.does: The bill only she pays, the toll, the Fitters, passing, respawn ahead of the edge, the endings.

parts.name: card
parts.does: The log on receipts, the card with the manifest and the galaxy's name.

parts.name: hold
parts.does: The flat field of batch-ark-1, retired in 0.1.1: the ground runs on coldsnap.

parts.name: the scale option
parts.does: One scaling law across the rig, the balance controller, and the leg lengths; the stance at 0.607 does not hold.

parts.name: the parts page
parts.does: This page: the generator, the table, the views, the feedback store.

parts.name: the spine refresh
parts.does: Coldsnap's plain files at 111b9cb into the tree, verbatim by hash.

parts.name: the seam
parts.does: The hull down as bodies with the factor, the status back up, one clock.

parts.name: the ground on coldsnap
parts.does: The crash as welds, the Grip in waves, repair with drag, walls and guns, the walker with the leap, the boss, men by name, the engineer on foot, infection, the registry.

parts.name: the gate by seed
parts.does: State, holder, toll, bill on the galaxy; the blockade on the pirates.

parts.name: the mech bay
parts.does: The walker rides only if a mech bay is welded.

parts.name: the save
parts.does: The whole run as one saved thing.

parts.name: dialogue and the ship computer
parts.does: Lines as data; the ship's flat voice.

parts.name: the camera law
parts.does: The star in every frame; the held shot.

parts.name: the ground's light
parts.does: One light from the star, reddening per landing.

parts.name: the hands' words
parts.does: The walk when unpaid, the home line, the card's dead.

parts.name: tramps that leave
parts.does: The exodus as a brain change on deadweight's tramps.

parts.name: the storyteller
parts.does: The seeded pacer, quiet at zero.

parts.name: sound
parts.does: Coldsnap's engine on the ground.

parts.name: the space screen
parts.does: Deadweight's flight and drawing under the ark's rail, in its own file.

parts.name: the hangar screen
parts.does: The build screen at a dock, in its own file.

parts.name: the ground screen
parts.does: The coldsnap renderer with the hold's rail, in its own file.

parts.name: the dock pane
parts.does: Listings, the purse, hands, the people contract, in its own file.

parts.name: the gate pane
parts.does: The bill, the toll, the Fitters' stall, in its own file.

parts.name: the card
parts.does: The manifest, the dead, the eaten, the name, in its own file.

parts.name: the gate's state hidden until the rumour or arrival
parts.does: The map shows the gate; its state is the one thing the map does not show. Lean: hidden.

parts.name: running a blockade under fire
parts.does: Allowed, as the lock law already lets a hull outrun. Lean: allowed.

parts.name: the five unbacked module kinds withheld
parts.does: Mounts, racks, shields, thrusters, and the mech bay leave every listing until their mechanism lands. Lean: withheld.

parts.name: the Fitters as machines
parts.does: They buy scrap, spares, modules, and her, never people; the button that sells people at the gate goes. Lean: machines.

parts.name: infection
parts.does: A clawed hull carries the Grip, a landing marks the world, the dead rise there, a station scrubs for a price. Lean: in.

parts.name: tramps, this order or later
parts.does: Plain bodies on a burn schedule leaving the near stations. Lean: later.

parts.name: the storyteller, later
parts.does: The seeded pacer with a quiet dial at zero. Lean: later.

parts.name: the Militia's levy
parts.does: One hand per dock at its stations unless a levy is paid. Lean: in.

parts.name: the star's name
parts.does: Named for death. MORS proposed; HEL and THANATOS the alternatives.

parts.name: the Charter's rumour
parts.does: A listing line that shows the gate's state and bill before you reach it, for a price.

parts.name: places by role
parts.does: No fixed names: the ash world under the Militia, the Charter's step, the Wreckers' roost. Role words for climates, holders, and stations.

parts.name: the first line in the log
parts.does: The walker's driver's name, and he walks in the first wave.
